description: Source code for a ValidationService class that handles validation runs, report generation, and retrieval for data submissions, including schema conformance, freshness, and completeness checks.

classes.name: ValidationService
classes.description: Service class for executing validation runs, generating reports, and managing validation data.

methods.name: run_validation
methods.description: Executes a validation run for a submission, generates a report, stores artifacts, updates submission state, and records an audit event.

methods.name: get_validation_report
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report by validation run ID, loading from stored JSON if available.

methods.name: list_validation_runs
methods.description: Lists all validation runs associated with a specific submission.

methods.name: _check_schema_conformance
methods.description: Checks if the dataset hash is a placeholder; fails if so, otherwise passes.

methods.name: _check_freshness
methods.description: Performs a dummy freshness check, always passing.

methods.name: _check_completeness
methods.description: Performs a dummy completeness check, always passing.
